messages.subject: Upcoming distance sampling workshops: camera trap distance sampling, animals missed on transect line, design and simulation
parts:
Dear distance sampling list,

In the coming weeks we will hold the following live online training workshops:

- Camera trap distance sampling, 19-23 September 2022

- Distance sampling when animals are missed at zero distance, 28 & 31 October 2022

- A practical guide to distance sampling survey design and simulation, 1 - 4
November 2022

For more information about the workshops, please see
https://workshops.distancesampling.org/

Registration for all three workshops will open soon. Meantime, we welcome
applications for a free place via our widening participation scholarships.
These are intended to encourage participation in our distance sampling workshops
by scientists from countries with fewer resources, and from groups traditionally
under-represented in wildlife science. For more information about these
scholarships and how to apply, please see
https://workshops.distancesampling.org/widening-participation
The scholarship deadlines are 23rd August for the camera trap workshp and 5th
September for the other two workshops.

With best wishes, Len Thomas
